title: Alignment without Transfer: Tokenization Impacts Cross-lingual Representations during Multilingual Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.27491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tokenization represents one of the most crucial steps in mulilingual NLP pipelines. Yet, tokenizers routinely under-allocate vocabulary to low-resource languages. While improved allocation leads to better performance, it remains poorly understood how tokenization shapes cross-lingual representations and transfer during pretraining. To address this, we pretrain 39 mono- and bilingual 1B decoder-only models on FineWeb2-HQ across English, German, French, Arabic and Chinese, varying only the tokenizer. Our results demonstrate that improved vocabulary allocation (i) substantially raises cross-lingual representation alignment in early-to-mid layers, an effect that prior work measuring only the output layer could not observe, (ii) increases cross-lingual parametric knowledge sharing in feed-forward neurons, supported by correlational and causal evidence, and (iii) an alignment-transfer dissociation, where cross-lingual transfer remains essent

translated_title: 无迁移的对齐：分词器影响多语言语言模型预训练过程中的跨语言表示
translated_abstract: 分词是多语言自然语言处理流程中最关键的步骤之一。然而，分词器通常对低资源语言的词表分配不足。尽管改进的词表分配能够带来更好的性能，但分词如何在预训练过程中塑造跨语言表示与迁移仍鲜为人知。为解决这一问题，我们在FineWeb2-HQ数据集上预训练了39个单语和双语的10亿参数解码器模型，涵盖英语、德语、法语、阿拉伯语和中文，仅改变分词器这一变量。我们的结果表明，改进的词表分配 显著提升了模型早期至中期层的跨语言表示对齐，这一效应是先前仅测量输出层的工作所无法观察到的； 增加了前馈神经元中的跨语言参数化知识共享，并得到了相关性证据和因果证据的支持； 揭示了“对齐-迁移分离”现象，即跨语言迁移基本保持不变。原文在此处截断。
tldr: 本研究通过仅改变分词器预训练39个单语和双语模型，发现改进的词表分配能显著增强模型中早期层的跨语言表示对齐以及前馈神经元的跨语言知识共享，但揭示了表示对齐与跨语言迁移之间存在分离现象。
en_tdlr: By pretraining 39 mono- and bilingual models varying only the tokenizer, this study shows that improved vocabulary allocation substantially enhances cross-lingual representation alignment in early-to-mid layers and knowledge sharing in feed-forward neurons, revealing a dissociation between alignment and cross-lingual transfer.
